summary: Multiple fixes make Gecko Media Plugins (GMPs) more robust at startup, shutdown, and during plugin queries: avoid warnings when storage is missing, remove brittle thread-id hacks in crash reporter init on macOS, wait for plugin registration before answering queries, settle init promises when GMP threads exit, and validate plugin version strings. Together these changes reduce startup races, avoid spurious errors, and make DRM/codec plugins behave more predictably.
